_comment: Scenes for tools/check/picture_check.py: each is captured at `seconds` of game time, with `env` driving the game there (MKDD_INPUT presses; see docs/runtime.md). `max_over8` is the largest share of pixels (percent) allowed to be more than 8 of 255 off Dolphin's render of the same frame in any channel, and `max_over48` the largest share more than 48 off. Scenes marked slow are skipped unless --slow is given. Only the first seconds are here: the title screen, a menu and a race (one, two and four players) are to be scripted once the game runs (docs/graphics.md, 'To check once the game runs').
